# NFL Daily — 2026-11-21 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Colts released QB Daniel Jones and turn to Anthony Richardson as the starter. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50542293/colts-release-qb-daniel-jones-blowout-loss-texans)
- Patriots coach Mike Vrabel said Tommy DeVito will start at QB in Week 12 vs. the Chargers; Drake Maye and WR A.J. Brown would normally be IR candidates, but New England is nearing its roster limit after a season ravaged by injuries. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries) — also [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2124110068308144411)
- Rams WR Puka Nacua had season-ending knee surgery. [RapSheet](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2123961129881718969)
- Cardinals downgraded QB Carson Beck (back) to out for Sunday's game at Kansas City; Josh Johnson — their fourth different starting QB in four weeks — gets the start. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50553035/cardinals-downgrade-qb-carson-beck-josh-johnson-set-start)
- Titans DL Jaylen Harrell was hospitalized after a serious car accident in Tampa. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50551434/titans-dl-jaylen-harrell-hospitalized-car-accident-tampa)
- Carmelo Anthony publicly rebuked Ravens CB Marlon Humphrey over his "criminals" remark about Baltimore, accepting his apology but challenging him to back it with action. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50548223/carmelo-anthony-calls-ravens-humphrey-baltimore-remark)

## Transactions
- _No qualifying transactions in this window._

## Injuries
- Cardinals QB Carson Beck (back) is out for Sunday's game at Kansas City; Josh Johnson starts in his place. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Rams WR Puka Nacua (knee/toe) is out for the rest of the regular season. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Packers DE Micah Parsons (knee) and RB Josh Jacobs (finger) were both out this week but practicing, with both working toward a Week 12 return. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Cowboys CB DaRon Bland was placed on injured reserve. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2124224993408274507)
- Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield (foot/thumb) is questionable for Sunday vs. the Lions with a plantar fascia injury. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-11-21 (Past 1 day)

## Key news
- Basketball Hall of Famer and Baltimore native Carmelo Anthony publicly rebuked CB Marlon Humphrey over his "criminals" remark about the city this week, accepting Humphrey's apology but demanding he back it with action. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50548223/carmelo-anthony-calls-ravens-humphrey-baltimore-remark) — also [The Banner](https://www.thebanner.com/sports/ravens-nfl/ravens-marlon-humphrey-carmelo-anthony-baltimore-criminals-podcast-R3R5MXX4EZEUVPTUKOGONWA5Q4/)

- Steelers LB Nick Herbig (hip/ribs) was downgraded to out for Sunday vs. the Eagles; LB Patrick Queen (hand) is a game-time decision. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2124192263337136430)
